items.title: Meta Ads: $304.70 spend, 22 leads, $13.85 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Catch-up window 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-19 (6 days, closing the gap since the last successful run on 2026-08-14 which covered spend through 2026-08-13) spent $304.70 across the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 22 leads at $13.85 CPL. That's roughly in line with the 7-day trailing baseline (~$13.53 CPL), which substantially overlaps this window since both pulls end on 2026-08-19. Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Gap catch-up: the last successful meta-ads run was 2026-08-14 (covering spend through 2026-08-13); no run happened 2026-08-15 through 2026-08-19 (5 missed days). This run widened to --days 6 (2026-08-14 to 2026-08-19) to cover the full gap with no missed day, per the window rule (capped at 7).

Because the catch-up window (6 days, 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-19) and the standard 7-day baseline pull (2026-08-13 to 2026-08-19) both end today's 'yesterday' and overlap on 5 of 6 days, the baseline CPL used for comparison (~$13.53) is not a fully independent prior period this run — treat the anomaly check as approximate until tomorrow's run restores a clean non-overlapping baseline.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 22 over this window, matching the counted leads exactly, same pattern flagged on 2026-08-14). No discrepancy in the counted total, but this recurrence suggests the script's lead-action set may need extending — a script change, not something to hand-patch in this file.
